title: Invertibility of a supplied compatible finite-free evaluation map
statement: On a small ringed site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let E,K be integer-indexed complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Suppose E has zero differential, finite interval support, and finite-free terms; suppose K has homology only in degree zero. Put P=Hom(E,K) [def-pur-hom-complex] with fixed projections [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. Given morphisms f:H^n(P)->Hom(H^(-n)(E),H^0(K)) and c:Z^n(P)->Hom(Z^(-n)(E),Z^0(K)) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] satisfying both displayed evaluation identities, f is invertible. No existence assertion is made.

source.place: finite-free Hom calculation, expanded using Tag 0A8X

proof.text: Apply finiteFreeZero_homologyProduct to E,K,n. It supplies all coordinate homology maps, a limiting fan, and compatibility of each coordinate with any lift of its cycle projection. This is the finite-free product calculation, with no concentration assumption.

For p not equal to -n, hK makes K.homology(p+n) zero. Internal Hom into a zero sheaf is zero: homObjMap(id,id) is its identity, and homObjMap(id,0) is zero sectionwise. Construct the inverse to the surviving projection of the limiting fan by the identity at -n and zero at all other coordinates. Fan uniqueness proves both inverse identities.

Mathlib HomologicalComplex.isIso_iCycles and isIso_homologyπ apply to the zero E differentials. Precompose c with the inverse E cycle inclusion to obtain d. Functoriality of homObjMap and hc identify d with the ambient coordinate lift. The product theorem gives its quotient equation. Combine this with hf and cancel the epimorphism P.homologyπ n; f followed by the two source-transport isomorphisms equals the surviving projection. IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right concludes.

theorem finiteFreeZero_homologyEvaluation_iso
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {S : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf S CommRingCat.{u})
    (E K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose S (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) (hK : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 0 → IsZero (K.homology k))
    (hzero : ∀ a b : ℤ, E.d a b = 0)
    (hsupp : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (E.X k))
    (hfree : ∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X k ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (f : (homComplex (R := R) E K).homology n ⟶
      SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (E.homology (-n)) (K.homology 0))
    (c : (homComplex (R := R) E K).cycles n ⟶
      SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (E.cycles (-n)) (K.cycles 0))
    (hc : c ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.iCycles 0) =
      (homComplex (R := R) E K).iCycles n ≫
        (Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists (R := R)))
          E K n (-n) 0 (by omega) ≫
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (E.iCycles (-n)) (𝟙 _))
    (hf : c ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 _) (K.homologyπ 0) =
      (homComplex (R := R) E K).homologyπ n ≫ f ≫
        SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (E.homologyπ (-n)) (𝟙 _)) :
    IsIso f
